node: Sub-100nm barium titanate and dielectric powders for high-end MLCCs
summary: US-tradable exposure to this node is thin because the most direct merchant dielectric-powder suppliers are Japanese or Chinese local-listed names. The cleanest US-accessible direct node candidate found in this pass is Sakai Chemical via OTC foreign ordinary SACIF. Murata and TDK are included as reference/context anchors because they are major MLCC leaders and direct users or internal producers of advanced dielectric powder. Vishay is included as a lower-confidence underfollowed US-listed second-order customer because it manufactures MLCCs but its exposure to AI-server high-end MLCCs and dependence on sub-100nm merchant BaTiO3 require verification.
